en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from someone who was from Ray, who said:

I went to Abil Ḥasan Al-‘Askari (Imam Hādi (a.s.)) and he asked me, “Where are you coming from?” I replied, “I went to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.).” Imam (a.s.) said, “If you had gone to the Ziyārah of the grave of Abdil ‘Ażīm who is (buried) near you, you would have been like those who have gone to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
